name: principle-foundational-thinking
purpose: Choose core data, access patterns and ownership before logic; sequence foundations so later work stays simple.
triggers: Choosing core types and data structures before logic
Considering state shared by concurrent actors
inputs: Required behavior and dominant access patterns
outputs: Core data and ownership design, coherent work sequence, and actual implementation checks when authorized and available
ordinaryExample: Before building a job queue, define job state and worker ownership, trace claim and status queries, and isolate concurrently mutable state.
capabilityLimits: Source inspection requires available inputs; edits require authorization and writes; checks require observed execution.
Unavailable writes or execution permit a reduced design proposal; missing source keeps designs provisional.
Preserve disable-model-invocation metadata without assuming host enforcement.
